scripts.help:
echo '
Track Your Regions - Available Commands
========================================

General:
  help                     Show this help
  build                    Build backend + frontend
  lint                     Lint backend + frontend + packages/shared
  lint:fix                 Lint and auto-fix backend + frontend
  typecheck                Type check backend + frontend + packages/shared
  gates                    What this change asks for: every gate, run or skipped, with its reason
  check                    The fast gates the change asks for (npm run gates lists them; check:all runs every one)
  check:all                Every fast gate, whatever changed
  knip                     Find unused files + dependencies
  knip:full                Full knip scan (includes exports/types)
  lint:circular            madge: find circular ts/tsx imports in all three packages
  lint:shell               shellcheck on every tracked *.sh (Docker)
  lint:docker              hadolint on every tracked Dockerfile (Docker)
  lint:actions             actionlint on every .github/workflows file (Docker)
  lint:md                  markdownlint on every tracked *.md: what does not render
  lint:links               lychee on every tracked *.md: dead links and anchors (Docker, offline)
  review:surface           How much review this branch asks for, against the budget

Python (cv-python):
  setup:py:dev             First-time setup: create cv-python/.venv and install all deps + dev tools
  lint:py                  Ruff lint cv-python
  lint:py:fix              Ruff lint + auto-fix
  format:py                Ruff format check
  format:py:fix            Ruff format apply
  typecheck:py             mypy on cv-python/app
  check:py                 lint:py + format:py + typecheck:py
  test:py                  cv-python pytest with coverage + the GADM loader tests

Development:
  setup                    First-run: create .env + admin account (run once)
  dev                      Start all services (Docker), rebuilding images so deps match package.json
  dev:stop                 Stop all services (Docker)
  dev:restart              Stop, rebuild, and start all services
  dev:backend              Start backend only (local, no Docker)
  dev:backend:stop         Stop backend container
  dev:backend:rebuild      Rebuild and restart backend container
  dev:backend:restart      Stop, rebuild, start backend
  dev:frontend             Start frontend only (local, no Docker)
  dev:frontend:stop        Stop frontend container
  dev:frontend:rebuild     Rebuild and restart frontend container
  dev:frontend:restart     Stop, rebuild, start frontend
  dev:frontend:preview     Serve the production build from the dev stack (what performance is measured on)
  dev:frontend:dev         Back to the dev server
  dev:frontend:mode        Say which of the two the dev stack is serving

Testing:
  test                     Run backend + frontend unit/integration tests (the shared package specs run in the backend lane)
  test:fast                Alias of test
  test:coverage            Run backend + frontend coverage
  test:e2e:smoke           Run Playwright smoke E2E
  test:e2e:full            Run Playwright full E2E
  test:db                  Run the database-backed backend specs (a real Postgres, not the mocked pool) inside the isolated test stack; a gate in the map
  test:py                  Run the Python tests: cv-python (with coverage) + the GADM loader
  test:db-migrate          Run the shell tests for the migration runner against the dev Postgres (local only, outside the gate map)

Performance:
  perf                     Lighthouse lane: production build on the isolated test stack, budgets in frontend/perf/lighthouse-budgets.json
  perf:size                Build the frontend and check the bundle-size budget (size-limit)
  perf:api                 Latency probe (p50/p95) of the hot read endpoints against a running stack
  perf:local               Everything this machine can measure on its own data: size + Lighthouse on the dev stack in production shape + the probe (the slow tier)

Logs (follow mode):
  logs                     All services
  logs:backend             Backend only
  logs:frontend            Frontend only
  logs:db                  Database only
  logs:martin              Martin only

Database:
  db:up                    Start PostgreSQL container
  db:down                  Stop PostgreSQL container
  db:create [name]         Create new database and switch to it
  db:list                  List all databases
  db:use <name>            Switch to a database (restarts Martin)
  db:drop <name>           Drop a database (not golden)
  db:status                Show current DB info
  db:shell                 Open psql shell
  db:load-gadm             Load GADM data (~30 min)
  db:migrate               Apply pending db/migrations/ files and record each one
  db:migrate:status        What this database has been through, and what is pending
  db:types                 Regenerate backend/src/db/schema.generated.ts from a fresh database built by db/init (Docker)
  db:types:check           Fail when that file and the schema disagree; a check-tier gate
  db:baseline [--through NNN]  Record pending migrations as applied WITHOUT running them
  db:seed:e2e              Seed the E2E fixture (backend env must name a test DB)
  db:dump [file]           Dump DB to file
  db:restore file          Restore DB from dump
  db:run-sql               Run SQL from stdin (pipe a .sql file)
  db:make-admin <email>    Grant admin role to a user
  db:mark-golden           Protect current DB from deletion
  db:unmark-golden         Remove golden protection

Martin:
  martin                   Start Martin standalone (reads active DB)
  martin:restart           Restart Martin Docker container
  martin:stop              Stop Martin container
  martin:logs              Follow Martin logs

Security:
  security:scan            Semgrep SAST scan (Node, via Docker)
  security:deps            npm audit for backend + frontend + packages/shared
  security:py:bandit       Python SAST (Bandit) on cv-python/app
  security:py:semgrep      Semgrep SAST scan (cv-python, via Docker)
  security:py:deps         pip-audit for cv-python/requirements.txt
  security:py:all          Run all Python security scans
  security:image           Build cv-python image and run Trivy CVE scan
  security:all             The check and scan tiers the change asks for (slow Semgrep, Trivy)

Codebase Export:
  repomix                  Pack codebase into AI-friendly XML file

Tip:
  npm run                  Show all script names from package.json
'
scripts.predev: test -f .env || echo 'No .env found - run: npm run setup (continuing with built-in compose defaults)'
scripts.dev:restart: docker compose down && docker compose up --build
scripts.dev:backend:restart: docker compose stop backend && docker compose up -d --build backend
scripts.dev:frontend:restart: docker compose stop frontend && docker compose up -d --build frontend
scripts.build: npm --prefix backend run build && npm --prefix frontend run build
scripts.lint: npm --prefix backend run lint && npm --prefix frontend run lint && npm --prefix packages/shared run lint
scripts.lint:fix: npm --prefix backend run lint:fix && npm --prefix frontend run lint:fix && npm --prefix packages/shared run lint:fix
scripts.lint:circular: ./scripts/require-node-tools.sh madge && madge --extensions ts,tsx --circular backend/src && madge --extensions ts,tsx --circular frontend/src && madge --extensions ts --circular packages/shared/src
scripts.lint:docker: files=$(git ls-files '*Dockerfile*'); [ -n "$files" ] || { echo 'lint:docker: no tracked Dockerfiles found' >&2; exit 1; }; for f in $files; do echo "hadolint $f"; docker run --rm -i hadolint/hadolint:v2.14.0@sha256:27086352fd5e1907ea2b934eb1023f217c5ae087992eb59fde121dce9c9ff21e < "$f" || exit 1; done
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix backend run typecheck && npm --prefix frontend run typecheck && npm --prefix packages/shared run typecheck
scripts.setup:py:dev: ./scripts/require-python-312.sh && cd cv-python && python3.12 -m venv .venv && .venv/bin/pip install --upgrade pip && .venv/bin/pip install -r requirements.txt -r requirements-dev.txt
scripts.check:py: ./scripts/require-py-tools.sh ruff mypy && npm run lint:py && npm run format:py && npm run typecheck:py
scripts.knip: npm --prefix backend run knip && npm --prefix frontend run knip && npm --prefix packages/shared run knip
scripts.knip:full: npm --prefix backend run knip:full && npm --prefix frontend run knip:full && npm --prefix packages/shared run knip:full
scripts.perf:size: npm --prefix frontend run build && npm --prefix frontend run size
scripts.db:run-sql: docker compose exec -T db psql -U postgres -d $(cat .active-db 2>/dev/null || echo track_regions)
scripts.security:scan: docker run --rm -v "${PWD}:/src:z" semgrep/semgrep:1.171.0@sha256:bdf7013b2c3634a487671158da77c554f531742326b543a9464d2adf6c433ac8 semgrep scan --config p/owasp-top-ten --config p/nodejs --config p/react --config p/secrets --config p/default --error
scripts.security:deps: cd backend && npm audit --audit-level=moderate --omit=dev && cd ../frontend && npm audit --audit-level=moderate --omit=dev && cd ../packages/shared && npm audit --audit-level=moderate --omit=dev
scripts.security:py:semgrep: docker run --rm -v "${PWD}:/src:z" semgrep/semgrep:1.171.0@sha256:bdf7013b2c3634a487671158da77c554f531742326b543a9464d2adf6c433ac8 semgrep scan --config p/python --config p/owasp-top-ten --config p/secrets --config p/default --error /src/cv-python
scripts.security:py:all: npm run security:py:bandit && npm run security:py:semgrep && npm run security:py:deps
scripts.security:all: node scripts/gates.mjs run check && node scripts/gates.mjs run scan
